summary: Results-driven WordPress & Shopify Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, securing, and optimizing high-performing eCommerce, LMS, marketplace, SaaS, and lead-generation websites. Strong expertise in WordPress, Elementor Pro, Oxygen, Bricks, Divi, Shopify, WooCommerce, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL, extended into custom web application development with Laravel, React, TypeScript, and Supabase. Experienced in building custom plugins, client portals, and dashboards; integrating CRMs, APIs, and AI-powered automation (GoHighLevel, n8n, Make, LLMs); and delivering technical SEO, AEO/GEO, conversion optimization, malware removal, and hosting management. Successfully delivered 250+ projects, providing clients with secure, scalable, fast, and conversion-focused digital solutions.

bullets: Designed and developed responsive business, service, eCommerce, LMS, multilingual, and multi-vendor marketplace websites using Elementor Pro, Oxygen, Bricks, Divi, and Beaver Builder.
Built custom WordPress plugins, child themes, ACF-powered templates, dashboards, and admin interfaces tailored to client workflows.
Resolved bugs and plugin conflicts; handled cloning, migration, and redesign while preserving data integrity, redirects, and SEO rankings.
Performed malware removal, spam-link cleanup, security audits, and website hardening.
Managed cPanel, Hostinger, SiteGround, and WP Engine hosting, including DNS, SSL, email deliverability, and server configuration.
Optimized speed, Core Web Vitals, and SEO; built Google Ads landing pages, lead forms, and booking funnels.
Developed custom websites and web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, MySQL, Laravel, and React.
Built a SaaS recruiting platform (ATS) with email marketing using React, TypeScript, Supabase, and Vercel, including role-based access, multi-provider email sending, and accessibility compliance.
Developed PHP portals and LMS platforms with staff, client, and admin dashboards, scheduling, timesheets, and secure role-based access.
Integrated APIs and webhooks including Resend, SendGrid, Twilio, and Google APIs to automate workflows and communication.
Collaborated with clients and designers and maintained solutions for long-term stability.
Built and customized Shopify stores for dropshipping and eCommerce with a focus on conversion optimization.
Managed product research, listings, and complete store configuration from setup to launch.
Customized Shopify themes, integrated third-party apps, and optimized store performance.
Ensured mobile responsiveness and applied on-page SEO best practices.
